name: Chess
description: Tactical calculation depth, candidate move selection, blunder prevention, and positional prophylaxis.

dimensions.name: Tactical Calculation Depth
dimensions.description: Calculating forcing lines (checks, captures, threats) 3-5 moves ahead with tree pruning.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Calculates complete forcing variation without overlooking intermediate checks (zwischenzug).
rubricCriteria.70-89: Finds key tactic but misses quiet defensive resource or cleanest finish.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Calculates only 1-2 moves deep; misses opponent's counter-threat.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Calculational hallucination; assumes opponent makes cooperative moves.

dimensions.name: Blunder Prevention & Prophylaxis
dimensions.description: Rigorous sanity checks before committing to a move; spotting opponent's sneaky threats.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Checks all opponent replies before moving; identifies prophylaxis targets.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Solid safety check with occasional slight positional concession.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Allows tactical fork or pin that weakens pawn structure.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Hangs piece or falls into direct 1-move/2-move tactic.

dimensions.name: Positional Evaluation & Outposts
dimensions.description: Pawn structure, piece coordination, open files, king safety, weak squares.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Accurate long-term strategic plan; occupies critical outposts; restricts enemy pieces.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Good piece development; reasonable plan with slight tactical inaccuracies.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Passive piece placement; allows opponent to dictate tempo.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Damages own pawn structure unnecessarily; leaves king vulnerable.
